scripts.daemon:build: pnpm --filter @agentping/storage-sqlite build && pnpm --filter @agentping/http-api build && pnpm --filter @agentping/daemon build
scripts.dashboards:start: pnpm run daemon:build && sh -c 'pnpm run daemon:start & node packages/dashboard-manager-server/dist/cli.js --config packages/dashboard-runner/config/dashboards.yaml --port 3030 --host 127.0.0.1'
scripts.dashboards:kill: for p in 3030 5173 5174 5175 5176 5177 5178 5179 5180 5181 5182 5183 5184 6006 6007 6008 6009 6010 6011 7890 7891 3000 3001 3003 8080; do lsof -tiTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; done; pkill -f 'next dev' || true; pkill -f 'next start' || true
